claim_text: Jumper et al. (2021) reported that AlphaFold predicts protein structures with atomic-level accuracy, often competitive with experimental structures.
source_sentence: AlphaFold demonstrated that a neural network can predict protein three-dimensional structure with atomic accuracy even where no similar structure is known (Jumper et al., 2021).
cited_source_raw: Jumper, J. et al. Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature, 2021.
notes: Real Nature paper (DOI 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2); abstract explicitly states atomic accuracy.

claim_text: Jinek et al. (2012) showed that Cas9 is a programmable, dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease that can be directed to cut specific DNA sites.
source_sentence: The demonstration that Cas9 could be programmed with a single guide RNA established the basis for CRISPR genome editing (Jinek et al., 2012).
cited_source_raw: Jinek, M. et al. A Programmable Dual-RNA-Guided DNA Endonuclease in Adaptive Bacterial Immunity. Science, 2012.
notes: Real Science paper (DOI 10.1126/science.1225829); abstract supports the programmable endonuclease claim.

claim_text: Abbott et al. (2016) reported the first direct observation of gravitational waves from a binary black hole merger.
source_sentence: The LIGO detection confirmed a century-old prediction of general relativity (Abbott et al., 2016).
cited_source_raw: Abbott, B. P. et al. Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger. Physical Review Letters, 2016.
notes: Real PRL paper (DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.116.061102); abstract states first direct detection.

claim_text: Takahashi and Yamanaka (2006) demonstrated that adult fibroblasts can be reprogrammed into induced pluripotent stem cells by four defined factors.
source_sentence: Induced pluripotency was first achieved by introducing four transcription factors into mouse fibroblasts (Takahashi and Yamanaka, 2006).
cited_source_raw: Takahashi, K. and Yamanaka, S. Induction of Pluripotent Stem Cells from Mouse Embryonic and Adult Fibroblast Cultures by Defined Factors. Cell, 2006.
notes: Real Cell paper (DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2006.07.024); abstract supports reprogramming of adult fibroblasts.

claim_text: Polack et al. (2020) reported roughly 95% efficacy for the BNT162b2 mRNA COVID-19 vaccine in a phase 3 trial.
source_sentence: The pivotal trial found the mRNA vaccine was 95% effective in preventing symptomatic COVID-19 (Polack et al., 2020).
cited_source_raw: Polack, F. P. et al. Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine. New England Journal of Medicine, 2020.
notes: Real NEJM paper (DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2034577); abstract states 95% efficacy.

claim_text: Barabasi and Albert (1999) showed that many real-world networks have a scale-free, power-law degree distribution arising from preferential attachment.
source_sentence: Scale-free structure was proposed as a common organizing principle of complex networks (Barabasi and Albert, 1999).
cited_source_raw: Barabasi, A.-L. and Albert, R. Emergence of Scaling in Random Networks. Science, 1999.
notes: Real Science paper (DOI 10.1126/science.286.5439.509); abstract supports scale-free/power-law finding.

claim_text: Deng et al. (2009) introduced ImageNet, a large-scale hierarchical image database organized according to the WordNet hierarchy.
source_sentence: ImageNet provided the large annotated dataset that later enabled deep learning breakthroughs in vision (Deng et al., 2009).
cited_source_raw: Deng, J. et al. ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database. CVPR, 2009.
notes: Real CVPR paper (DOI 10.1109/CVPR.2009.5206848); abstract describes the ImageNet database.

claim_text: Hochreiter and Schmidhuber (1997) introduced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to address the vanishing gradient problem in recurrent networks.
source_sentence: LSTM units use gating to preserve gradient information over long sequences (Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997).
cited_source_raw: Hochreiter, S. and Schmidhuber, J. Long Short-Term Memory. Neural Computation, 1997.
notes: Real Neural Computation paper (DOI 10.1162/neco.1997.9.8.1735); abstract supports LSTM/vanishing-gradient claim.

claim_text: The Transformer architecture was first introduced by Devlin et al. (2018) in the BERT paper.
source_sentence: Self-attention as the sole sequence-transduction mechanism was first proposed in the BERT paper (Devlin et al., 2018).
cited_source_raw: Devlin, J. et al. BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding. 2018.
notes: Misattribution: BERT uses Transformers but did not introduce them (Vaswani et al., 2017 did). The cited source is BERT, not the Transformer paper.

claim_text: Jumper et al. (2021) concluded that AlphaFold cannot predict protein structures more accurately than traditional homology modeling.
source_sentence: The AlphaFold authors reported their method did not improve on homology modeling (Jumper et al., 2021).
cited_source_raw: Jumper, J. et al. Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature, 2021.
notes: Wrong finding: the cited paper reports atomic-accuracy predictions, the opposite of this claim.

claim_text: Jinek et al. (2015) were the first to describe Cas9 as a programmable dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease.
source_sentence: The programmable nature of Cas9 was first reported in 2015 (Jinek et al., 2015).
cited_source_raw: Jinek, M. et al. A Programmable Dual-RNA-Guided DNA Endonuclease in Adaptive Bacterial Immunity. Science, 2012.
notes: Wrong year: the cited landmark paper is 2012, not 2015.

claim_text: Polack et al. (2020) reported that the BNT162b2 mRNA COVID-19 vaccine was only 62% effective against symptomatic disease.
source_sentence: The phase 3 trial found 62% efficacy for the mRNA vaccine (Polack et al., 2020).
cited_source_raw: Polack, F. P. et al. Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine. New England Journal of Medicine, 2020.
notes: Wrong number: reported efficacy was ~95%, not 62%.

claim_text: Barabasi and Albert (1999) demonstrated that most real-world networks follow a Poisson (Erdos-Renyi random) degree distribution.
source_sentence: Real networks were shown to be well described by classical random-graph (Poisson) degree distributions (Barabasi and Albert, 1999).
cited_source_raw: Barabasi, A.-L. and Albert, R. Emergence of Scaling in Random Networks. Science, 1999.
notes: Wrong finding: the paper argues for scale-free/power-law, explicitly contrasting with Poisson random graphs.

claim_text: ImageNet was introduced by Krizhevsky et al. (2012) as part of the AlexNet paper.
source_sentence: The ImageNet dataset was first released alongside AlexNet (Krizhevsky et al., 2012).
cited_source_raw: Deng, J. et al. ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database. CVPR, 2009.
notes: Misattribution: the cited source (Deng et al., 2009) is the actual ImageNet paper; the claim credits the wrong authors/year.

claim_text: Abbott et al. (2016) reported that LIGO found no statistically significant evidence of gravitational waves.
source_sentence: The 2016 LIGO analysis reported a null result for gravitational waves (Abbott et al., 2016).
cited_source_raw: Abbott, B. P. et al. Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger. Physical Review Letters, 2016.
notes: Wrong finding: the cited paper reports the FIRST direct detection, not a null result.

claim_text: Hochreiter and Schmidhuber (1997) concluded that recurrent networks with sigmoidal units do not suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients.
source_sentence: The LSTM paper argued that standard RNNs already handle long-range dependencies without gradient decay (Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997).
cited_source_raw: Hochreiter, S. and Schmidhuber, J. Long Short-Term Memory. Neural Computation, 1997.
notes: Wrong finding: the paper is motivated precisely by the vanishing-gradient problem that LSTM is designed to solve.

claim_text: A recent internal study found a 12 ms end-to-end latency improvement in the serving system.
source_sentence: Our serving stack improved end-to-end latency by 12 ms in a recent internal study.
notes: No citation provided; nothing to resolve against.

claim_text: Smith et al. (2023) reported a 3.4% accuracy gain on an internal benchmark.
source_sentence: Prior work reported a 3.4% gain on the benchmark (Smith et al., 2023).
cited_source_raw: Smith et al., 2023.
notes: Citation far too generic to resolve to a specific DOI; internal benchmark not public.

claim_text: According to a 2022 personal communication, the method scales linearly with the number of nodes.
source_sentence: The approach scales linearly with cluster size (personal communication, 2022).
cited_source_raw: Personal communication, 2022.
notes: Personal communication is inherently unverifiable — no retrievable source.

claim_text: An internal technical report documented a 2x throughput speedup over the previous system.
source_sentence: Throughput doubled relative to the prior release (Acme Labs Technical Report TR-2021-07).
cited_source_raw: Acme Labs Technical Report TR-2021-07, 2021.
notes: Unpublished internal technical report; not indexed, cannot be retrieved.

claim_text: Prior work has shown that transformer models are robust to moderate input token corruption.
source_sentence: Transformers have been shown to tolerate moderate input corruption (prior work).
cited_source_raw: prior work
notes: Vague hand-wave citation with no author, title, or year to resolve.

claim_text: Doe (2019) established in an unpublished PhD thesis that the regret bound is tight.
source_sentence: The bound was shown to be tight (Doe, PhD thesis, 2019).
cited_source_raw: Doe, J. PhD thesis, University of Somewhere, 2019 (unpublished).
notes: Unpublished thesis; typically not resolvable via CrossRef/Semantic Scholar.

claim_text: Nguyen and Patel (2020) measured a 7% reduction in data-center energy use from their scheduler.
source_sentence: A 7% reduction in energy use was reported for the proposed scheduler (Nguyen and Patel, 2020).
cited_source_raw: Nguyen, T. and Patel, R. Journal of Obscure Systems Studies, 2020.
notes: Obscure/likely non-indexed venue; citation should fail to resolve to a checkable source.

claim_text: A forthcoming 2024 paper will prove the proposed algorithm is asymptotically optimal.
source_sentence: We will prove asymptotic optimality in forthcoming work (2024).
cited_source_raw: Forthcoming, 2024.
notes: Forthcoming/unpublished; no source exists yet to verify against.
